us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the latest available wire and national reports

articles.title: Trump administration asks Supreme Court to let mail-voting order proceed
bullets: The Justice Department asked the Supreme Court to pause lower-court blocks on Trump’s mail-voting executive order.
The order would create a federal citizenship list for eligible voters and restrict mail-ballot delivery to that list.
Democratic-led states and D.C. challenged the order, arguing election rules are set by states and Congress.

articles.title: Wisconsin tornado damages homes and knocks out power to thousands
bullets: A tornado swept through the Appleton, Wisconsin, area on Monday.
The storm splintered homes, downed trees and cut power to thousands.
Local officials and utilities were assessing damage and restoration needs.

articles.title: Seattle food-festival shooting leaves three dead as police cite multiple shooters
bullets: Gunfire broke out at the Bite of Seattle festival near the Space Needle.
Authorities said three people were killed and several others were wounded, including a toddler.
Court documents reviewed by AP said at least three shooters were involved.

articles.title: Trump defends tariffs in Michigan as Canada levies threaten auto state
bullets: Trump visited a General Motors facility in Milford, Michigan, to tout his economic agenda.
The trip came as new tariffs on Canadian goods raised concerns for Michigan businesses.
The visit also intersected with competitive midterm primaries in the state.

articles.title: ICE extends major Texas detention-center contract despite closure calls
bullets: ICE plans to extend the no-bid contract for Camp East Montana in El Paso through September 2027.
The extension could add up to $776 million in taxpayer cost, according to the notice cited by AP.
Advocates had called for the site’s closure over reported human-rights concerns.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Major international developments from recent wire coverage

articles.title: Macron visits southwest France wildfire zone as mass evacuations continue
bullets: President Emmanuel Macron visited a firefighting coordination center near Bordeaux.
Officials said the wildfire burned an area four times the size of Paris.
About 220,000 people were forced to flee as crews battled unpredictable conditions.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia says it shot down drones fired from Iraq
bullets: Saudi Arabia said drones launched by Iran-backed militias in Iraq targeted its territory.
The Defense Ministry said petroleum facilities and Riyadh were among the targets.
The report came amid mediation efforts to ease U.S.-Iran escalation.

articles.title: Zelenskyy visits Britain as new prime minister pledges support for Ukraine
bullets: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy met British Prime Minister Andy Burnham in England.
Burnham said the visit signaled Britain’s continued support for Kyiv.
The visit followed renewed Russian drone attacks and Ukrainian strikes tied to Iran-linked shipping.

articles.title: Pakistan monsoon death toll tops 100 as more heavy rain is forecast
bullets: Pakistan’s disaster agency said monsoon rains and flash flooding killed more than 100 people over a month.
Forecasters warned additional heavy rain was expected later in the week.
The flooding added pressure to emergency services during peak monsoon season.
articles.source: Associated Press / The Washington Post World Wires

articles.title: Hurricane Genevieve briefly reaches Category 5 in eastern Pacific
bullets: Genevieve became the first Category 5 hurricane in the eastern Pacific in two years.
The National Hurricane Center said the storm was expected to remain far from land.
Tropical Storm Fausto was also bringing large surf to Hawaii as it weakened.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Key India-focused developments and market updates

articles.title: Modi government faces pressure from youth protest leaders over exam leaks
bullets: Reuters reported fresh government talks with Gen-Z protest leaders in New Delhi.
Protesters demanded Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan’s resignation over exam-paper leaks.
The movement grew after police crackdowns and disruptions to transit and internet access.

articles.title: Indian shares edge lower as Nifty and Sensex slip
bullets: The Nifty 50 closed down 0.05% on Tuesday.
The BSE Sensex 30 declined 0.09%.
Losses in capital goods, power and public-sector stocks weighed on the market.

articles.title: India and Ivory Coast discuss deeper defence cooperation
bullets: Cote d’Ivoire Air Force chief Major General Koffi N’Guessan Alfred visited New Delhi.
He met Indian Air Chief Marshal AP Singh at Air Headquarters.
The talks focused on military-to-military engagement and defence ties.

articles.title: India continues Commonwealth Games campaign on Day 6 in Glasgow
bullets: Indian athletes competed across boxing, weightlifting, athletics, swimming and bowls.
Weightlifting and women’s boxing were among India’s major medal opportunities on Tuesday.
The live schedule followed a strong Monday in which India won six medals.

articles.title: Indian courts issue fresh service-law rulings across states
bullets: LiveLaw tracked several July 28 court updates from Kerala, Allahabad and other high courts.
The Kerala High Court asked the state to consider paid menstrual leave for KSRTC women conductors.
The Allahabad High Court ruled maternity leave for a second child cannot be denied solely over a two-year-gap rule.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Notable U.S. equity movers and market-rotation stories

articles.title: Paramount Skydance jumps in midday trading
bullets: Paramount Skydance surged more than 31% in the reported midday movers list.
The move marked its best trading day ever, according to the market-movers report.
The stock led a broad list of notable single-name moves.
articles.source: CNBC / 区块链网 market-movers summary

articles.title: Cava slides after weaker sales update
bullets: Cava shares fell about 15% in the midday movers report.
The company missed second-quarter revenue and same-store sales forecasts.
The restaurant chain’s update pressured sentiment around high-growth dining stocks.
articles.source: CNBC / 区块链网 market-movers summary

articles.title: Capri rises after JPMorgan upgrade
bullets: Capri Holdings gained about 8% in the reported midday movers list.
JPMorgan upgraded the stock, citing potential for multi-year revenue growth.
The move stood out among retail and consumer-discretionary names.
articles.source: CNBC / 区块链网 market-movers summary

articles.title: CoreWeave drops after earnings despite strong revenue
bullets: CoreWeave fell about 18% after reporting results.
The company cited capacity constraints even as revenue remained strong.
The move weighed on AI-infrastructure and neo-cloud sentiment.
articles.source: CNBC / 区块链网 market-movers summary

articles.title: Bullish surges in NYSE debut after $1.1 billion crypto IPO
bullets: Bullish opened at $90, far above its $37 IPO price.
The crypto exchange raised about $1.1 billion in the offering.
The debut underscored investor demand for public crypto-market exposure.

business.label: Business
business.subtitle: Corporate, trade and consumer-business stories moving boardrooms

articles.title: Walmart expands grocery discount for 1.6 million employees
bullets: Walmart extended its employee discount deeper into grocery aisles.
The move comes as tariffs renew inflation concerns for consumers.
The policy affects roughly 1.6 million employees.

articles.title: Port of Los Angeles breaks century-old volume record amid tariff rush
bullets: The Port of Los Angeles processed more than 1 million TEUs in July.
Importers front-loaded cargo to get ahead of tariff deadlines.
Shipping executives said the surge reflected tariff-driven supply-chain behavior.

articles.title: Coffee and tea prices climb as tariffs pressure retailers
bullets: Coffee prices rose sharply year over year, according to the CNBC summary citing BLS data.
Specialty teas and tariff-sensitive goods also showed price pressure.
Small retailers and importers warned margins were being squeezed.

articles.title: Goldman stands by forecast that consumers will bear tariff costs
bullets: Goldman Sachs maintained its view that consumers will absorb much of the tariff burden.
The call came after Trump criticized one of the bank’s economists.
The forecast adds to debate over how import taxes flow through to prices.

articles.title: Tariff whiplash complicates brands’ supply-chain diversification
bullets: Importers and brands are rethinking China-alternative sourcing strategies.
Reports cited India as one destination companies explored for lower-cost production.
Tariff uncertainty has made planning harder for small and mid-sized businesses.

tech.label: Tech
tech.subtitle: AI, cybersecurity and platform stories dominating technology coverage

articles.title: Perplexity makes $34.5 billion bid for Google’s Chrome browser
bullets: Perplexity AI made an unsolicited all-cash offer for Chrome.
The bid was valued at $34.5 billion, above Perplexity’s own reported valuation.
The move comes amid antitrust scrutiny of Google’s browser and search businesses.

articles.title: Large U.S. companies describe how AI is reshaping workforces
bullets: CNBC reviewed how major companies are deploying AI tools internally.
Use cases include software development, customer service, support and sales productivity.
Analysts remain divided on whether AI will drive large net job losses.

articles.title: xAI co-founder Igor Babuschkin leaves to start venture firm
bullets: Elon Musk’s xAI lost co-founder Igor Babuschkin, according to CNBC coverage tracked by Techmeme.
The departure adds to senior leadership changes across AI startups.
Babuschkin is leaving to launch a venture firm.

articles.title: U.S. reportedly used trackers in AI-chip shipments to detect China diversion
bullets: Reuters reported that U.S. investigators embedded location trackers in selected AI-chip shipments.
The tracking reportedly targeted illegal diversions to China.
The report cited shipments involving servers from companies such as Dell and Super Micro.

articles.title: AI-powered browsers evaluated for news summaries and bias effects
bullets: A new arXiv paper analyzed 41,331 summaries from AI-powered browsers.
The study covered Google Chrome with Gemini, Microsoft Edge with Copilot and Perplexity Comet.
Researchers assessed accuracy, political bias and negative affect in browser-generated summaries.
